name: Dwars door Vlaanderen - A travers la Flandre ME
story: From the start, many attacks were launched, but none were allowed to go clear. With just over 50 kilometres to go, three riders broke away. On the Eikenberg, Wout van Aert bridged across to the two reaming leaders. The trio stayed together until the first passage of Nokereberg, where Grégoire dropped, leaving Van Aert and Larsen out front. On the final climb, Van Aert accelerated, dropping Larsen and going solo. Behind, Filippo Ganna launched a counterattack. Ganna closed in on Van Aert in sight of the finish, launched the sprint and took victory in the fastest edition ever.
